t: A LoRa radio board with GPS, sensors, a screen, and an 18650 battery holder.
steps: Buy the T-Beam Supreme from the LilyGO store. Pick a licence-free band for your country and the pre-flashed Meshtastic version for the easiest start.
Buy one flat-top 18650 cell without a protection board.
Screw on the LoRa antenna before you power it up.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Set your region in the app to match local radio rules.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE and pick ESP32S3 Dev Module with PSRAM turned on.
Open a sensor example from the LilyGO LoRa Series repo and set the board type in utilities.h.
meta: Open Board. From $33.30. A few stores.
